company.name: Prototyping.io
company.shortDescription: Prototyping.io provides an AI-driven platform to analyze CAD designs and manufacture custom mechanical parts.
company.description: Prototyping.io provides an AI-driven manufacturing platform for mechanical parts based on customer CAD designs. The company enables users to upload 3D models, receive automated design for manufacturability feedback, and select suitable production options. Its system plans and executes production across processes such as CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, 3D printing, injection molding, extrusion, and die casting. Prototyping.io generates machine programs, coordinates manufacturing workflows, and manages quality control to deliver functional prototypes and production parts. The service targets engineering and product teams that need precision components with support for complex geometries and tight iteration cycles. The platform focuses on automating the path from design intent capture through manufacturability analysis to finished parts.
